{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Full frontend E2E tests

# The full matrix against stage: every pair, token and order type, including
# the tests tagged @full that PR runs leave out, and the claim tests. PR runs
# (frontend-e2e-tests.yml) check one representative case per path.
#
# It runs on the stage -> master release PR, against the stage build being
# released, so every release gets the full matrix; `release-gate` is the check
# to require on master. It can also be run by hand from the Actions tab.
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]
    branches:
      - master

# One run per release PR (a newer push to stage replaces it); manual runs
# queue behind each other.
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || 'manual' }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  # Waits until the stage deployment of the commit under test (the release
  # PR's head, or the commit a manual run started on) is live, so the tests
  # run against it rather than the previous build. Other PRs into master
  # (hotfix branches, forks) and draft release PRs skip the suites; the
  # suites spend real funds.
  stage-deploy:
    if: github.event_name != 'pull_request' || (github.head_ref == 'stage' && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork == false && github.event.pull_request.draft == false)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 50
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Check out deployment lookup
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          sparse-checkout: .github/scripts
      - name: Wait for the stage deployment
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          EVENT: push
        run: bash .github/scripts/wait-cf-deployment.sh

  wallet-tests:
    needs: stage-deploy
    timeout-minutes: 45
    runs-on: macos-26
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
          sparse-checkout: |
            /package.json
            /yarn.lock
            /.yarnrc.yml
            /.yarn-4.18.1.cjs
            /packages/*/package.json
            /packages/web/etc/
            /packages/e2e/
      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          package-manager-cache: true
          node-version: 24.x
      - name: Install Playwright
        run: yarn workspaces focus app-osmosis-e2e && npx playwright install chromium
      - name: Cancel leftover open orders
        continue-on-error: true
        env:
          PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.E2E_PRIVATE_KEY_PREVIEW }}
          ACCOUNT_LABEL: "E2E Test Account (pre-test cleanup)"
          # The wallet is shared with PR runs; leave their in-flight orders alone.
          MIN_ORDER_AGE_MINUTES: "20"
        run: npx tsx packages/e2e/scripts/cancel-all-orders.ts
      - name: Run wallet tests
        working-directory: packages/e2e
        env:
          BASE_URL: https://stage.osmosis.zone
          PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.E2E_PRIVATE_KEY_PREVIEW }}
          E2E_FULL: "true"
        run: npx playwright test swap.osmo.wallet swap.usdc.wallet trade.wallet claim portfolio transactions
      - name: Upload test results
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v6
        with:
          name: full-wallet-test-results
          path: packages/e2e/playwright-report

  no-wallet-tests:
    needs: stage-deploy
    timeout-minutes: 30
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
          sparse-checkout: |
            /package.json
            /yarn.lock
            /.yarnrc.yml
            /.yarn-4.18.1.cjs
            /packages/*/package.json
            /packages/web/etc/
            /packages/e2e/
      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          package-manager-cache: true
          node-version: 24.x
      - name: Install Playwright
        run: yarn workspaces focus app-osmosis-e2e && npx playwright install chromium
      - name: Run pools and pair selection tests
        working-directory: packages/e2e
        env:
          BASE_URL: https://stage.osmosis.zone
          E2E_FULL: "true"
        run: npx playwright test pools select trade-quote-select --workers 2
      - name: Upload test results
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v6
        with:
          name: full-no-wallet-test-results
          path: packages/e2e/playwright-report

  # The required check on master: passes only when the stage build was live
  # and both suites passed. It runs on manual runs too: a manual run tags the
  # same commit as the release PR, and a skipped check would count as passing.
  # For a fork or draft release PR it fails, since stage-deploy was skipped.
  release-gate:
    if: always() && (github.event_name != 'pull_request' || github.head_ref == 'stage')
    needs: [stage-deploy, wallet-tests, no-wallet-tests]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check every job passed
        env:
          NEEDS: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
        run: |
          FAILED=$(jq -r 'to_entries[] | select(.value.result != "success") | "\(.key): \(.value.result)"' <<< "$NEEDS")
          if [ -n "$FAILED" ]; then
            echo "These jobs did not pass:"
            echo "$FAILED"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Full E2E matrix passed on the stage build."
",
  "rationale": "The workflow explicitly disables the package manager cache (`package-manager-cache: false`) in both test jobs, so dependencies are fetched fresh on every run. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern (dependency cache) is supported by the pattern catalogue: it applies when repeated dependency fetching is measurable and cache inputs include the lockfile and environment. Both preconditions hold here — every run executes `yarn workspaces focus app-osmosis-e2e`, the root `yarn.lock` is included in the sparse checkout, and dependencies are pinned. Enabling the cache (changing `package-manager-cache: false` to `true`) preserves all build and test coverage, adds no new network access, secrets, or privileged actions, and only reuses dependency downloads across runs. The workflow already implements cancel-in-progress (P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE) and per-job timeouts (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT), so those patterns need no change.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
